eve.text: Eirdu and its counterpart Isilu are the twin worldsouls of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, and in Eventide, Oona's death collapses the artificial cycles, so the plane enters the Pendulum Year before Eirdu and Isilu restore balance.

After the final Great Aurora, Eirdu and Isilu reemerge to control the plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor. Oko cures Maralen with dawnglow, and Eirdu appears to offset Isilu, so Rhys is at peace.
Eirdu and Isilu reunite, rebalancing the plane's cycle, and Rhys, freed of the pact's magic, dissolves into Eirdu's light.
